description: Replaces the hours when appointments or tables can be booked. One row per period, several per day allowed (e.g. 10:00-14:00 and 17:00-21:00). Days not listed are closed. For restaurants "to" is the last time a table can be booked. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

name: set_opening_hours
title: Set opening hours for bookings
